pyqgis_plugin.name: ARTE+ - Arma Reforger Terrain Exporter (erosion fork)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Advanced QGIS terrain exporter for Arma Reforger (Enfusion Engine), with hydraulic erosion and per-feature road/river shaping.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Fork of ARTE by Icebird. Adds hydraulic erosion, per-feature road and river shaping, live previews, and a NoData border fix.
